name: Kokoro-82M Stage 2 v11 Best Checkpoint (decoder-init fix)
short_description: Kokoro-82M StyleTTS2 Stage 2 fine-tune with the decoder-init bug fixed (first_stage_path repointed at a genuine HiFi-GAN-shaped pretrained checkpoint), trained 50 epochs on t0012's 1,531-clip LUFS-normalized corpus, and gate-verified to produce real audible speech.
architecture: StyleTTS2 Stage 2 fine-tune of Kokoro-82M (82M params). Decoder initialized from yl4579/StyleTTS2-LibriTTS's epochs_2nd_00020.pth (a genuinely HiFi-GAN-shaped checkpoint, resblock_kernel_sizes=[3,7,11], upsample_initial_channel=512, upsample_rates=[10,5,3,2]) instead of v10's mismatched istftnet-shaped first_stage_v3.pth. Packaged as the same 5-module state dict convention as kokoro-v10-best: bert, bert_encoder, predictor, text_encoder, decoder.

hyperparameters.first_stage_path: epochs_2nd_00020.pth (yl4579/StyleTTS2-LibriTTS) -- genuinely HiFi-GAN-shaped, unlike v10's mismatched first_stage_v3.pth
hyperparameters.val_data: unchanged val_96 (data/val_list.txt), confirmed 0 overlap with train_data

files.description: 5-module extracted state dict (bert, bert_encoder, predictor, text_encoder, decoder), 331 MB. Extracted via tasks.t0008_tts_eval_harness_baselines.code.extract_decoder.extract() from epoch_00048.pth (epoch 48/50, val_loss 0.3469, flagged_healthy=true). DVC-tracked.
Training configuration used for v11 run (joint_epoch=30, diff_epoch=10, epochs=50).
